notes.title: Exoprimal Season Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Exoprimal.

With the release of Title Update 4, all planned Exoprimal seasonal content has been finished.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a4e672794a71df18392e107fd071e12b54ed6d03.jpg[/img]

After Season 4, which concludes on July 11th, Season 1 will return. From there, a new season will begin on the first of each month.
In addition, Season Passes 1-3 will be available for sale again. This will allow players to obtain items from all seasons.
[b]* All online services will continue to be available.[/b]

Please check the link below for details about the Season 1-4 cycle, Savage Gauntlet, Time Loop Rebellion, seasonal campaigns, Double EXP Campaigns, and more events moving forward.
[b]* Please note that ranks for Savage Gauntlet will no longer be tabulated after Trial 41.[/b]

[h3][url=https://info.exoprimal.com/pages/other_20240705_001/]Future Events and Survival Passes[/url][/h3]


All gameplay modes will remain available to play. This includes the main Dino Survival mode, as well as endgame content such as Savage Gauntlet and Time Loop Rebellion.
If you're playing alone or match with only a few other players, Bots (AI-controlled Exofighters) will still be added so that you can fully enjoy the Hammerheads' story and reach the ending.

The Exoprimal team appreciates your interest and support, and we hope to see you in the wargame!

[h3]New Rigs[/h3]
・Mortar

These new rigs can be purchased with BikCoins once you reach the required player level.

[h3]New Modules [/h3]

[h3][b]Base Modules[/b] [/h3]
[h3]Exotic Module[/h3]
When an Overdrive is activated, the player triggering it and Friendly Exofighters equipped with this Module will both receive a temporary boost to attack strength.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/f688a61dc2fcf51c6840199ac062ff08fdbabdc6.png[/img]

This module is built with Overdrives in mind.
Since this module also activates among team members with the same module equipped, mindful coordination with your allies is key to making the most of it.

[h3]Ace Module[/h3]
The Ace Module is for those who never stop fighting.
When a fighter equipped with this module has the highest score among all fighters upon reaching a set score threshold, that player will receive every buff. However, they'll remained detected by hostile Exofighters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/06279a65c05f05683d73ad91cd95d2a8c8345b1b.png[/img]

This module lets you power up based on your performance.
As long as you have the highest score, your attack, defense, and movement speed will increase.
Aim to get the highest score before anyone else.

[h3][b]Action Modules[/b][/h3]
[h3]Z - Impact Strike[/h3]
Reduces the damage of Linear Strike and the like in exchange for emitting a shockwave upon activation.
This shockwave will explode after reaching a distance, blowing back the enemy considerably.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/e6d6b43cdef1434c102de3aa25350f9098b1d3f5.png[/img]

This module alters the properties of the Zephyr Series' Linear Strike.
The shockwave has the capability of snagging Hostile Exofighters and small enemies, making it easy to link with other skills.

[h3]K Enhance Dome[/h3]
Reduces the cooldown time for all skills for both the player who activates it and any allies while in the Dome Shield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/f69438e8da9ce962735f9930412245efc81dc1b8.png[/img]

This module alters the properties of the Krieger Series' Dome Shield.
This increases the fighting capability of your team by allowing you and your allies to use skills more frequently.


Various other Modules have also been added.

The new Base Modules and Action Modules 
change how the Exosuits fight.

These new Modules are being added to Player Level Rewards and Beta Variant Series Suit Level Rewards.

[h3]Neo Triceratops Savage Gauntlet Boss Battle[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/65c453288a860a8966cf8c7cba940e3d2c809c8d.png[/img] [/h3]
Try to finish the excruciatingly difficult 5-person PvE Missions.
Boss battles will be regularly added into the Savage Gauntlet schedule so you can enjoy a variety of gameplay encounters.
* Check the information site for details on the Savage Gauntlet.

[h3]New Mode: Time Loop Rebellion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/39403399757d215072c64dfd3441136185417d61.png[/img]

The Time Loop Rebellion is new high-difficulty PvE content that remixes the final battle against the Leviathan.
Play repeatedly to earn Rebellion Points, which are used to obtain rewards.
Work in groups of up to 10 fighters to win the battle.

Time Loop Rebellion is only available for a limited time.

[h3]New Mode: Custom Match[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/730ad3242c784942ad646c229089978fda0badd4.png[/img]

We've added Custom Match mode, letting you send passcodes to other players to take on the dino menace together!
Enjoy wargames with friends across platforms, playing in game modes, missions, and fields of your choice.

Check here for more details about the Custom Matches.

[h3]New Medals [/h3]

[h3]New Awards [/h3]
[h3][b]For the Glory[/b][/h3]
This special award is obtained by reaching Level 3 for a certain number of Medal Awards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/36b8a7903b6840b9d116abcf19bf1e55c4dccc01.png[/img]

[h3][b]High-end Exofighter[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/6d1d65335014dddd16e705c5b6e6d1e46183228f.png[/img]

[h3][b]Legendary Pilot[/b][/h3]
This special award is obtained by reaching Suit Level 50 for 30 Exosuits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/0cb9ac0dd85aa37117a19d0937c8fc271c532fc8.png[/img]

Other Awards have been added.


[u][h1] Game Balance Adjustments[/h1][/u]

[h3]Exosuit Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a2b035180f9b281d965fffa0d82c787df51dd287.png[/img]
[b]Exosuit: Zephyr α [/b]

 There was a disparity between the Primary Attack range and the Skill attack range, making it difficult to inflict instantaneous damage. As a result, the Primary Attack damage reduction has been reduced to allow damage to be dealt even when in closer than optimum range.
Also, there were many cases where, when fighting against shooting-type exosuits, you would lose before doing any damage. Because of this, its health has been reexamined.
[list]
[*]Health has been increased from 350 to 400.
[*] The distance-based damage reduction for the Dragon Chakram Primary Attack has been softened.[/list]

[b]Exosuit: Barrage [/b]

Out of all of the exosuits, this exosuit was designed to excel at dealing massive damage amongst many targets. However, due to Burning Heart's instant firepower, it was able to deal massive damage to one enemy target.
As a result, Burning Heart's damage has been decreased. The risky health reduction trade-off in exchange for that instant firepower has also been made more severe to adjust its practical applications during gameplay. Additionally, the default Barrage's Health has been reexamined, as well.

Furthermore, the Stun Grenade's cooldown has been extended, as when paired with the B - Boost Grenade, it had a high rate of preventing Hostile Exofighters from moving. Additionally, to make it more effective against enemy dinosaurs, each hit will deal a higher stun value, making it much easier to stun medium-size dinosaurs and above.
[list]
[*]Reduced Health from 500 to 450. (Default suit only.)
[*] The damage of the Burning Heart Overdrive has been decreased. VS Dinosaurs: From 5000 to 4000. Versus Fighters: From 1600 to 1000. (Applies to all Barrage Series.)
[*]The health reduction of Barrage when using the Burning Heart Overdrive has been increased. (Applies to all Barrage Series.)
[*]Stun Grenade's cooldown time has been increased from 10 to 14 seconds. (Applies to all Barrage Series.)
[*]Hitting a dinosaur's head with a Stun Grenade is much more likely to stun them. (*Applies to all Barrage Series.)
[/list]

[b]Exosuit: Krieger [/b]

Due to the long length of Dome Shield's cooldown, it was difficult to protect allies as a Tank Suit immediately after its destruction.
By reducing the cooldown of Dome Shield, we expect that it'll be quick to recover after it has been destroyed, making it both easier to use and giving Tank Suits more opportunities to shine in combat.
[list]
[*] Dome Shield's cooldown has been reduced from 23 to 19 seconds.
[/list]

[b]RIG [/b]

On Rigs with high durability, shields can frequently be used in combination with the Rig Loading Module.
However, it was easy to defend against attacks from both Dinosaurs and Hostile Exofighters, making this Rig used more frequently than others.
As a result, we have increased the Shield's cooldown in order to change when it's selected. We expect this to make other Rigs more viable options to choose, as well as enabling Tank Suits to flourish more often.
[list]
[*] The cooldown of Rig Shields has been extended from 17 to 24 seconds.
[/list]

[b]Dominator[/b]

Sometimes Triceratopses summoned by Dominators had difficulty in defeating enemies due to reasons such as there being few locations for Hostile Exofighters to fall.
To account for this, the damage that Hostile Exofighters take when hitting a wall is increased. These adjustments make it so that the Dominator is both reliable and viable to use on any field.
[list]
[*] Increased damage when a Triceratops summoned by a Dominator knocks a Hostile Exofighter into a wall: From 400 to 600.
[/list]

[h3]Game Mode Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] In Dino Survival, when PVP Priority is selected for the Final Mission Priority Setting, rules for Escape, Neo T. Rex Battle, and Neo Triceratops Battle rules will not be included.
[*] The conditions for Capcom Collab Missions have been lowered.
[*]The required Score and Suit EXP for certain Medals has been increased.
[*] A wider variety of contributions will now be commended more often on the results screen.
[*] when a time-out occurs during Savage Gauntlet matching, The game will start with a Bot replacing The player who timed out.
[/list]

[u][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/u]
[h3]Exosuit Adjustments[/h3]
[b]Exosuit: Vigilant[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the firing speed of Vigilant α's Primary Attack would sometimes vary based on framerate.
[/list]

[b]Exosuit: Roadblock[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where after a counter blast is fired while equipped with the R03 - Road Forger module for the Roadblock β and the exosuit is then unequipped, the counter blast damage would increase.
[*]An issue was fixed where the effect of R - Intimidation for the Roadblock series would not sometimes work properly depending on the target's distance.
[/list]

[b]Exosuit: Murasame[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where damage would not accumulate under specific circumstances even when blocking while using Vajra Counter.
[/list]

[b]Exosuit: Skywave[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where when Skywave α's lightning bolt is blocked, the blocking player's damage would incorrectly vary based on the direction they were facing.
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug for some Action Modules where the damage-boosting effect would not correctly apply to α and β series exosuits.
[*]Fixed a bug where the controller would not vibrate when taking certain attacks.
[*]Increased the number of anti-aliasing options.
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug for Rathalos and Neo Triceratops battles where enemies would sometimes become transparent. 
[*]Fixed a bug for the Neo Triceratops battle where players could become stuck in certain positions.
[*]Fixed a bug where incorrect damage values would be displayed when a Kinetic Rock would reflect off of a Neo Triceratops' shield.
[*]Fixed a bug where deploying a shield with Roadblock β while near a Sniper Neosaur could sometimes trigger a self-destruct.
[/list]

[h3]UI Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*]The text for how to obtain The The Influence Emote was fixed.
[*]Other typos in the game text have been fixed.
[/list]

[h3]Achievements/Trophies[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the "Cretaceous Eradicator" achievement/trophy wouldn't be awarded despite the Battle Records listing 100,000-plus dinosaurs being defeated.
[/list]

Other minor bugs have also been fixed.


The Exoprimal team appreciates your interest and support, and we hope to see you in the wargames!

notes.title: Introducing a New Mode: Custom Match
notes.content:
Title Update 4 introduces the Custom Match mode.

[h3][b]New Mode: Custom Match[/b][/h3]
Enjoy wargames with friends across platforms as you play with your preferred settings, missions, and fields. In Custom Matches, you'll not only earn EXP for your Player, Survival Pass, and Suit Levels, you'll even make progress on the story.

[h3][b]Six Game Type Settings[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/8e26b6cffac349621e51aad4ced6d18708ec078b.png[/img]
- Custom Game
Play Dino Survival with your choice of Final Mission and Field.

- Quick Brawl
Play only Final Missions.
Freely select the Final Mission and Field.

- Dino Survival
Advance the story as you play Dino Survival, the state of which is synchronized with the progress of other participating players.
Collaboration Missions are currently available. You can also get limited time campaign rewards.

- Savage Gauntlet
Play the currently available Savage Gauntlet. 

- Time Loop Rebellion
Play the currently available Time Loop Rebellion. 

- Unique Missions
Play through special story-related missions and ten-player co-op boss battles.

[h3][b]Starting a Custom Match[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/3ae6f8cee986e3ecf1404928d16fc83f7a741cb9.png[/img]
- Create a Room
Select "Create a Room" to generate a passcode and invite players to participate.
Share the passcode with players you want to play with. 

- Join a Room
Select "Room Search" to input the passcode you've received and enter the room.

[h3][b]Room Screen Explanation[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/e3c89cb3ea0c339aa2fe8ea503a33309fbe62700.png[/img]
* On the actual game screen, a platform icon will be displayed next to names of players on the same platform as you.
[olist]
[*]Select Game Settings, Missions, and the Field.
[*]A list of players who have joined will also be displayed.
The Room Leader, indicated by a flag icon, can determine the game settings, mission, and field.
Players who have completed the story will have a star icon displayed next to their name.
[*]Adjust the teams of the participants.
This can also be done randomly.
* Only the Room Leader can control this.
[*]The room's time limit.
The room will be disbanded if the game does not begin within the time limit. 
[/olist]
[h3][b]Custom Match Supplementary Information[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Regardless of the Custom Match Settings, the Crossplay Setting will be forced on.
[*]Rooms are created once at least two participating players have joined. 
* Depending on the timing, some rooms may not initially appear in search results while the room is being generated.
[*]Collaboration Missions cannot be done in a Custom Game or Quick Brawl.
[*]Limited-time campaign rewards cannot be earned in a Custom Game or Quick Brawl.  
[*]Savage Gauntlet can only be played with five players who have completed the story.
[*]Time Loop Rebellion can only be played with ten players who have completed the story.  
[*]Bots will automatically be added when there are not enough players.
[*]Once a Buddy Session has been initiated, the Session owner can Create Lobby or Find Lobby only when all members have gathered in the Main Menu.
* All Buddies will join the custom room selected by the session owner.
* If a player other than the session owner leaves a Custom Match, they cannot rejoin the custom room as long as they remain in the Buddy Session.

[/list]
We hope that Custom Matches will help all fighters up their game even further.
We hope you'll keep on enjoying the wargames.

[u][h1]New Content and Features[/h1][/u]
[h3]A new map has been added.[/h3]
Jungle
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/153e6c2de0440278830d745803b9a381cc0d2d38.png[/img]

[h3]A new Final Mission has been added.[/h3]
Eliminate the Neo Triceratops
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/65c453288a860a8966cf8c7cba940e3d2c809c8d.png[/img]

Neo Triceratops is a neosaur comparable in power to Neo T. Rex and Durban.
Work in groups of up to 10 fighters to take it down.

[h3]Introducing Beta variant exosuits![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/4a6b3baf94b8dd2b6429b197436af92c4c8091a2.png[/img]

[b]Deadeye β: Energy MG[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/f834b32a24d24c96ae48f840a619e046bf2434ea.png[/img]

[b]Barrage β: Fire Spray[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/3ece3e2877c55f37e15571d8cff0b7497e1a5759.png[/img]

[b]Roadblock β: Counter Shield[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/b956d516a54b327a64efbf920f5d76531f6b188f.png[/img]

[b]Skywave β: Lifeline[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/5145e69a419e22108037eacb69e70d620567c789.png[/img]


The weapons equipped to these Beta variant series sport different attributes from your conventional exosuits, changing up the way you handle yourself in battle.
These Beta variant series can be purchased with BikCoins once the Alpha variant series suit reaches level 10. 


[h3]New rigs have been added.[/h3]
Stealth
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/50a3e4337362975eb82b3b18d69b4eb9d8e49b1d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/c6d631ce38f0c302f825ca3682b10780895cdc80.png[/img]

These new rigs can be purchased with BikCoins once you reach the required player level.

[h3]New Modules have been added. [/h3]

[h3][b]Base Module[/b] [/h3]
[h3]Hi-Xol Reusable Module[/h3]
The Overdrive Gauge will charge when Overdrive is used.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/33e64b9a54e10e824e6508f0a4c4ae9536cf5c24.png[/img]

This module revolves around Overdrives.
The gauge won't empty out even when an Overdrive is used, enabling you to fire off the next Overdrive even sooner.

[h3]Durban Module[/h3]
This module lets you fire at enemies as tenaciously as Durban himself.
Grants a boost to attack power and movement speed upon respawning after a knockout. The enemy fighter that previously defeated you will also be detected.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/3e2fd3315563ec0e2ed70235483bcaf590a11a31.png[/img]

This module offers enhanced support for direct combat against enemy fighters.
Not only will you respawn in a powered up state after being defeated, but the targeted enemy will be visible to all allies.

[h3][b]Action Modules[/b][/h3]
[h3]D - Compact Grenade[/h3]
Adds 1 additional use for the Rifle Grenade and reduces it cooldown time in exchange for a smaller explosion range and less damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/fc54604ae4c175e49250b0cce0c932de99cd907f.png[/img]

This module alters the properties of the Deadeye Rifle Grenade.
The Rifle Grenade can be used more frequently, amplifying Deadeye's overall adaptability even higher.

[h3]S - Graviton Echo[/h3]
Generates a shockwave with powerful suction when your primary attack hits the gravity cluster of the Graviton Cage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/cdace6c6209e9cdf8157b637c2b8195ad15073a6.png[/img]

This module alters the properties of the Skyline Graviton Cage.
When combined with your primary attack, it grants better control over enemies caught inside of the Graviton Cage.


Other Modules have been added.
The new Base Modules and Action Modules change how the default and Alpha Variant series Exosuits do battle.

These new Modules are added to Player Level Rewards and Beta Variant Series Suit Level Rewards.


[h3]New rewards have been added to the War Chest. [/h3]
[code]- EXOSUIT SKINS
- WEAPON SKINS
- DECALS
- CHARMS
- STAMPS
- EMOTES
- EMBLEMS
- BACKGROUNDS [/code]
[h3]New medals have been added. [/h3]

[h3]New awards have been added. [/h3]

[h3]Some menus and portions of the UI have been slightly adjusted.[/h3]
[code]A button that displays Suit Details such as Active Skills and the like has been added to the Suit Status screen and Rig/Module screens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/d4f6f0b97f0953dda5f5c745973637b00d8bf704.jpg[/img]

A function has been added to check the Modules attached to each Exosuit in the Suit Selection screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/23b07bd3be1c09d002e8455f5d33f2fad1a70e2a.jpg[/img]

・A function has been added that lists the names and unlock requirements for awards currently equipped to award plates seen on the player list of the results screen, buddy player information, etc.
[/code]

[u][h1]Bug Fixes & Balance Adjustments[/h1][/u]

[h3]Exosuit Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a2b035180f9b281d965fffa0d82c787df51dd287.png[/img]
[b]Exosuit: Krieger [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Krieger's Stunlock Missile would not inflict damage or paralyze small dinosaurs after a direct attack.[/list]

[b]Exosuit: Witchdoctor [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug on PlayStation®5 where the firing sound effects of ally Witchdoctor α players would continue to play.
[*] Fixed a bug where Witchdoctor's Feed would not properly restore energy after being used on a small dinosaur, which could lead to unintended issues.
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Repairs EX medal could only be obtained with the recovery skill of either Witchdoctor or Witchdoctor α.
[*] Fixed a bug where the High-End Skywave award could not be obtained with Skywave α.
[/list]

[h3]Game Mode Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjustments have been made in Dino Survival so that Missions and Dino Swarms matching the story progression will more readily appear.
[*] Adjustments have been made in Dino Survival so greater priority will be given to new fields based on story progression.
[*] Adjustments have been made in Dino Survival to the matching rate of select missions that occur only in the story.
[*] Bots will be equipped with modules based on the situation.
[*] Restrictions will be placed on players who leave in the middle of a Savage Gauntlet.
[code]- If a player leaves in the middle of the Savage Gauntlet, a restriction will be placed upon the next matching.
- If this restriction is active, a countdown timer will be displayed, during which, you will be unable to initiate Savage Gauntlet matching.
- Matching for a Savage Gauntlet will not start if a buddy member has a time limit.
- No restrictions will be placed upon you if you leave midway after another player has left.
- If the 5 players are buddies, there are no restrictions placed for leaving midway.[/code]
[/list]
[h3]UI Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where damage would sometimes be displayed incorrectly when a small dinosaur received multiple attacks in the same frame.
[*] Typos in the game text have been fixed.
[/list]

Other smaller bugs have also been fixed.


The Exoprimal team appreciates your interest and support, and we hope to see you in the wargame!

notes.title: Title Update 2 Contents
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/bb24b67e22c3071ba8e253117e3832d4532ede34.png[/img]

[u][h1]Update Time & Date[/h1][/u]
October 18th (Wed)

Please ensure that you have extra space before downloading the data.

[u][h1]New Season Begins[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/e291196b9adf62729eaadf42ee55a820983e6950.png[/img]

The Survival Pass rewards for this upcoming season will be different.

There will be also be Halloween and Holiday Campaigns taking place during this season, as well as a Double EXP Campaign.

From the launch of Title Update 2 until
January 18th, 2024 (Thu) 3:00 a.m. UTC

[u][h1]The Street Fighter 6 Collaboration Begins[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/57680a3962e7f3ba95b2db9ca23cf6734e917f10.png[/img]

Check here for more details about the collaboration.
[url=https://info.exoprimal.com/pages/update_231018_002/]The Street Fighter 6 Collaboration Begins![/url]


[u][h1]New Content and Features[/h1][/u]
[h3]A new map has been added.[/h3]
Ocean Platform
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/dc3dd03ab3b37b78de46c51fb844667e2f15d72c.png[/img]

[h3]A new Final Mission has been added.[/h3]
Escape
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/006c8f9e3e359febd27d5d3852e6821e5ceea8bf.png[/img]

[h3]New rigs have been added.[/h3]
EDGE STRIKE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a4a26b7660b58ec862d13e7ce23409247ef8046d.png[/img]

DRONE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/564ed776fdc420d9f31fda1dc274d53c4d4129d8.png[/img]
These new rigs can be purchased with BikCoins once you reach the required player level.


[h3]New Modules have been added. [/h3]
Anti-Swarm Module

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/49c673ecef568688c735010d4aa292bfb143f942.png[/img]


Magnum Module

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/720550520597422021090641232b144746e3a750.png[/img]

These new modules can be purchased with BikCoins once you reach the required player level.


[h3]Durban is being added to the Savage Gauntlet Boss Battles. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/cc391186f12d1f7a103eb7fbfe6b428fc02d9ed6.png[/img]
Try to finish the excruciatingly difficult 5-person PvE Missions. The rules are the same as in the Savage Gauntlet.
Boss battles will be regularly added into the Savage Gauntlet schedule so you can enjoy a variety of gameplay encounters.
* Please check the information site for details on the Savage Gauntlet.

[h3]Battle Records have been added, letting you view various play data. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/247ef1147623d5a1dbd32b8c9f9bf1cd3711915c.jpg[/img]
In the Database tab of the main menu, you can view Play Time, Victories, MVP Awards, Defeated Dinosaur Count, wargame and exosuit statistics such as craft placement counts, and other rig-related play data.

[h3]New rewards have been added to the War Chest. [/h3]
[code]- EXOSUIT SKINS
- WEAPON SKINS
- DECALS
- CHARMS
- STAMPS
- EMOTES
- EMBLEM
- BACKGROUND [/code]

[h3]New medals have been added. [/h3]

[h3]New awards have been added.  [/h3]

[h3]Some menus and portions of the UI have been slightly adjusted.[/h3]
[code]- An option has been added for all platforms to replace other player usernames with anonymous ones.
- Exosuit skin and weapon skin preview screens will display the names of the exosuits that can equip them.
- A shortcut button was added to change the page on the Career Player Level and Survival Pass screens.
- All fighter names will be displayed when cooperating with enemy teams in missions.
- The icon that displays where enemy exofighters have been knocked out has been adjusted, making it easier to see.[/code]

[u][h1]Known Bugs[/h1][/u]
We have confirmed a bug where the Repairs EX Medal can only be obtained with either Witchdoctor or Witchdoctor α's recovery skill.
A fix is planned where a recovery performed either by other exosuits, an Aid rig, or the Repair Boost craft will also let this medal be obtained.
We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused by these bugs.

[u][h1]Bug Fixes & Balance Adjustments[/h1][/u]

[h3]Exosuit Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a2b035180f9b281d965fffa0d82c787df51dd287.png[/img]
[b]Deadeye [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug for Deadeye α where bullets could fly significantly outside of the reticle when firing a shotgun at enemies from a close-rage.[/list]

[b]Vigilant [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug for Vigilant α where the controller sensitivity while using the 3x scope was too high. The sensitivity is now the same as default Vigilant.
[*] Fixed a bug for Vigilant α where fired bullets would not be displayed on other players' screens if they were over 120m away.
[/list]

[b]Krieger [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug for Krieger where the hit detection of its Stunlock Missile could be wrong based on the shooting player and hit player.
[*] Corrected errors in the effect description for Krieger α's A-40 Pulverizer.
[/list]

[b]Witchdoctor [/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected errors in the effect description for Witchdoctor α's Feed.
[/list]

[b]Modules[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected errors in the Lv2 effect descriptions for the Base Module and Conservation Module.[*]Corrected errors in the effect description for Vigilant Module V - Hailstorm.
[*]Corrected errors in the Lv3 effect description for Vigilant Module V - Hailstorm.
[*]Corrected errors in the effect description for Nimbus α Module N02-SG Mastery.
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the following medals could not be obtained when knocking out a hostile exofighter off of the field with a Dominator Large Dinosaur.
　Affected Medals
 - Suit Hunter
 - Double Domination
 - Three Course Meal
 - Suit Eater
 - Rampage
 - Apex Predator

[*] Fixed a bug related to High End series equipment where the scores of the default suits and variant suits were not calculated as part of the Exceptional Feats.
 
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/fde6a22cee0fabb3905ed80d549d84861ca9613e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where defense up and damage reduction effects were not applied in response to Umbral Neosaur’s attacks.
[*] Adjustments have been made to the AI routines for Pteranodon's new actions such as Stone Toss.
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when Krieger’s Dome Shield is used to defend against a massive Pteranodon swarm and damage dealt to frightened Pteranodons was massively increased.
[/list]

[h3]Game Mode Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjustments were made to increase the types of missions at the beginning of the game, including Final Missions.
[*] Adjustments were made to increase the types of dinosaurs that appear at the beginning of the game.
[*] Adjustments were made so special missions such as Trial Combat 0414 are more likely to appear than at present.
[*] With the addition of Escape, adjustements were made to the draw rates for Final Missions.
[/list]

[h3]UI Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the summoned large dinosaur would not sometimes appear on the radar when the enemy team activated a Dominator.
[*] Fixed a bug where certain decals displayed the wrong raraity when active.
The display position of such decals will be changed accordingly.
[*] Unintended names for some exosuit skins have been changed.
[*] Typographical errors in the game text have been fixed.
[/list]

A number of other, smaller bugs have also been fixed.


The Exoprimal team appreciates your interest and support, and we hope to see you in the wargame!

notes.title: Hammerheads HQ #7 – New “Escape” 10-Player Co-op Final Mission info!
notes.content:
Hey Exofighters,

Welcome to Hammerheads HQ #7!

We hope the wargames have been treating you well and your combat data is of the highest quality. Season 2 is on the horizon, arriving free to all players on October 18th, so we thought we’d delve a little deeper with you into some of the content that you’ll soon be able to enjoy as part of the update!

To help us do this, we’ve gathered some combat data of our own in the form of a message from Exoprimal’s Director Hiraoka on the new 10-player co-op final mission arriving in Season 2’s launch, “Escape”.

Before we hear from Director Hiraoka though, let’s have a recap on what’s been revealed to be coming to Exoprimal in the new season.


[h1]Exoprimal Season 2 Summary[/h1]

In September, we hosted our Capcom Online Program as part of the Tokyo Game Show, during which a new trailer for Exoprimal dropped, showcasing a new map, final mission, Rigs and more. Check it out below:

[previewyoutube=ULhaJx1AGOE;full][/previewyoutube]

So Exofighters, prepare for –
[list]
[*]New Field: Ocean Platform.
[*]New Final Mission: “Escape” – 10-player co-op PvE.
[*]New Rigs: Edge Strike & Drone.
[*]New Modules: [REDACTED]
[*]Special limited-time campaigns: Halloween & Holiday.
[*]Updated Survival Pass rewards: New cosmetics await.
[*]Capcom Collaboration 1: Street Fighter 6.
[/list]
Plus, we’ll be running our first [b]Double EXP Campaign[/b] from Friday, October 20, 3am UCT to Tuesday, October 24, 2:59am UTC!

The double EXP will apply to your Player level, Survival Pass level and yes, your Exosuit levels too!

Further information on all of the above can be found on the Exoprimal website [url=https://www.exoprimal.com/en-us/season/2.html]HERE[/url].

Now it’s about time we caught-up with Director Hiraoka to learn more about the “Escape” Final Mission. Take note, Exofighters, it might just help you survive the dino onslaught…


[h1]Director Combat Data – Final Mission: Escape[/h1]

[i]Hi everyone! This is Exoprimal director Takuro Hiraoka here to tell you about some exciting new additions to the game in Title Update 2!

Our goal with the title updates for Exoprimal is to add new content that changes the way you play and experience the main Dino Survival mode in an exciting way. For the first TU, we added the Variant Alpha Exosuits, which brought a fun new element of strategy to the player character. For this second TU, in addition to new rigs for the Exosuits, we are adding a new Ocean Platform map and the new final mission Escape, both of which change the nature of Dino Survival itself and bring a new experience to Exofighters. Today, I’d like to share some details about the Escape mission type.

Escape is a new kind of final mission that can occur during Dino Survival. Previous final missions have been based on the theme of competing against the other team, but Escape is about cooperating with them. When you hear Leviathan announce the final mission is Escape, you’ll have the surprising experience of suddenly needing to cooperate with the opposing team who you had been competing against until that point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/d0f41b2cd5a50ce52b55f258aec0706c3082f71f.jpg[/img]

The mission is divided into two broad phases, during which you must cooperate as a group of 10 Exofighters to follow Leviathan’s orders, not all of which will be straightforward. First, in the escape preparation phase, you’ll try to capture as many of the marked areas on the map as possible within the time limit. Exofighters will receive upgrades such as attack or defence boosts depending on the number of areas secured, so better performance here will be an advantage in the second phase. Capturing all the areas will be very difficult, especially as you will be teaming up with your foes from previous missions, but try your best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/a1f2a211e81003106fa1c3e19e45b5da35c3e26e.jpg[/img]

Once the area capture phase is over, you’ll proceed to the escape phase. Your goal is to get all Exofighters to the exit safely, in the midst of a huge amount of dinosaurs. Among the upgrades you can earn is one where crafting is automatically replenished, so crafting a lot is definitely a viable strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/185f4d98f04751a249717a386d7f62a6c0bf7f3f.jpg[/img]

If you can get not only yourself but the whole team out safely, you’ll be awarded a special medal which grants not just additional score but further rewards, so be sure to try for a full-team escape. Each time an Exofighter successfully escapes through the gate, extra time is added to the amount of time before the gate closes, so it’s essential not to give up until the absolute last as you try to secure the escape of every last Exofighter! 

I hope you enjoy the thrilling experience of teaming up and trying to escape during the short time window the gate is open. Remember, we’ve also added the new Ocean Platform map as well, which broadens the possibilities of Dino Survival even further and will see all kinds of new situations occur during gameplay. See you in the wargames![/i]


That wraps up the insight on the “Escape” Final Mission from Director Hiraoka! 

To summarise - Ready yourselves for a multi-phase experience where your rivals become allies and you must first secure key territory locations to bolster your 10-player team with buffs to aid in your escape.

After all, you’ll need all the support you can get when the second phase kicks in and you must reach the escape gate before it closes. There will be a huge amount of dinosaurs throughout this mission, challenging your PvE skills and teamwork as you seek to hold your ground and escape.

Remember, if you all escape and leave no Exofighter behind, you’ll be rewarded!

One last thing to aid you in surviving “Escape”, this Final Mission can occur on any Field, not just Ocean Platform. Prepare yourselves accordingly, Exofighters!


[h1]Golden Joystick Awards – Vote for Exoprimal![/h1]

In other news, we’re pleased to share that Exoprimal has been nominated for “Best Multiplayer” in the Golden Joystick Awards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/9ed5ba7b3a5a9d42ebe23dbc1227725be2624fc7.jpg[/img]

Your vote matters and can help Exoprimal secure victory, so demonstrate superior wargame performance and take a quick minute to vote for us [url= https://www.gamesradar.com/goldenjoystickawards/]HERE[/url]. Thank you!


[h1]Stand by for combat mission[/h1]

That wraps up the latest Hammerheads HQ post!

It won’t be long until Season 2 arrives on October 18th with a host of new content for you to enjoy. 
In the meantime, follow Exoprimal on [url=https://twitter.com/exoprimal]Twitter[/url] and like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Exoprimal]Facebook[/url] for the latest Exoprimal news.

Thanks, Exofighters, see you in the wargames!

- Exoprimal Community Team

notes.title: Season 2 Kicks Off October 18 with Title Update 2!
notes.content:
[b]Here's the latest information on Season 2 of Exoprimal! Check out the trailer below for a first look at contents coming in Title Update 2.[/b]

[previewyoutube=GVXw1-39eH8;full][/previewyoutube]
Exofighters will tasked to survive Leviathan's wargames with an array of new contents, including the Ocean Platform stage, the Edge Strike and Drone rigs, and a final mission called Escape where opposing teams join forces in ten-player co-op to complete mission objectives. Season 2 will also introduce seasonal events for Halloween and the winter holidays, giving players a chance to snag exclusive exosuit skins for a limited time. Be sure not to miss out on the double XP events either!

The Street Fighter 6 collaboration contents will be available as part of Title Update 2 as well, ushering in exosuit skins, decals, charms, stamps, and emotes inspired by the Street Fighter series. Exofighters can get their hands on these items by playing Dino Survival a specific number of times or purchasing paid cosmetic sets. 

Season 2 kicks off October 18 with the release of Title Update 2. See you in the wargames!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286320/Exoprimal/

notes.title: Title Update 2 Launch Date Change Announcement
notes.content:
Our aim was to make Title Update 2 available at the conclusion of Season 1.
However, the date has been postponed due to circumstances surrounding the development schedule.

As a result, the end of Season 1 and the start of Season 2 have changed to the following dates and times:

Previous Date: October 12th (Thu) 3:00 a.m. UTC
October 11th (Wed) 11:00 p.m. EDT

New Date: October 18th (Wed) 3:00 a.m. UTC
October 17th (Tue) 11:00 p.m. EDT

Along with this change, the Savage Gauntlet at the following time has been cancelled.

October 13 (Fri) 3:00 a.m. UTC
October 12 (Thu) 11:00 p.m. EDT

We sincerely apologize to players who are looking forward to the weekly Savage Gauntlet and the new Season and appreciate your patience in waiting for Season 2.

As always, thank you for playing Exoprimal. We hope to see you in future wargames!

[u][h1]New Content and Features[/h1][/u]
[h3]Introducing Alpha variant exosuits![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/3fa1d0d7d2331e551f393b812de6db358c6c6e84.png[/img]
[code]- Deadeye Alpha: Burst Fire 
- Zephyr Alpha: Energy Chakram 
- Barrage Alpha: Rocket Hop 
- Vigilant Alpha: Marksman 
- Roadblock Alpha: Fortress Shield 
- Krieger Alpha: Charge Shotgun 
- Murasame Alpha: Frost Glaive 
- Witchdoctor Alpha: Duality Beam 
- Skywave Alpha: Thunderclap 
- Nimbus Alpha: Double Barrel[/code]
These exosuit variants feature weapons that differ from their default counterparts and allow for different playstyles. 
Alpha suits can be purchased with BikCoins after increasing the suit level of a default suit to level 20. You can also use Early Unlock Tickets to unlock Alpha variants.

[h3]New modules have been added. [/h3]
Take advantage of 34 new modules that can be unlocked by increasing player level and Alpha variant exosuit level. 

[h3]Boss Battles are coming to Savage Gauntlet.  [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/550ce93db1a751f4b55049b4828609e2a398b71b.jpg[/img]
From this Title Update on, excruciatingly difficult 5-person PvE boss battle missions will be added to the Savage Gauntlet rotation. Check the information site for more info on when these boss battles will be available, and take on the Gauntlet with your team!

[h3]New items for the following categories can be obtained from War Chests.[/h3]
New exosuit skins, weapon skins, decals, charms, stamps, emotes, emblems, and player icon backgrounds can be obtained from War Chests.  

[h3]New medals have been added.   [/h3]

[h3]New awards have been added, and the design for some awards has been changed. [/h3]

[h3]Some menus and portions of the UI have been slightly adjusted. [/h3]
[code]- A respawn timer has been added next to the allied exosuit display in the bottom left of the screen. 
- You can now toggle between allied and enemy team members at the results screen that displays after Commendations are awarded. 
- You can now check a medal's score and Suit EXP values at the results screen that displays after Commendations are awarded. 
- The amount of BikCoins granted by a Suit Level reward is now visible at the Exosuit Status screen in the Hangar. 
- The slot number corresponding to a currently equipped module is now displayed on the module list at the Rigs & Module screen in the Hangar.[/code]

[u][h1]Bug Fixes & Balance Adjustments[/h1][/u]
[h3]Savage Gauntlet[/h3]
An issue was detected where some players experienced a discrepancy between the rank displayed in the game and the rewards granted to some players whose clear times are very close to the cutoff time for a given rank.
[url=https://info.exoprimal.com/pages/important_230803_001/]https://info.exoprimal.com/pages/important_230803_001/[/url]

notes.title: Hammerheads HQ #6 - Five More Alpha Variant Previews!
notes.content:
Hey Exofighters,

Welcome to Hammerheads HQ #6!

Following on from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286320/announcements/detail/3644026942360830775]last week’s blog post[/url], that revealed 34 new Modules and detailed 4 Alpha Variant exosuits,  as well as how you’ll unlock them in Title Update 1, we’re back a little earlier than usual with previews on the remaining 5 Alpha suits!

That’s a lot of suits to talk about, so let’s charge into today’s post like a Pachycephalosaurus that’s just seen you conveniently stood by a ledge.

Over to you, Director Hiraoka!


[h1]Director Combat Data – Alpha Variant Intel: Part 2[/h1]

[b]Murasame Alpha: Frost Glaive[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/e1386293445251df59c54f893469ce5f86b6a319.jpg[/img]

[i]Hello again, everyone!

Murasame may be a tank, but it's also a more proactive fighter than its fellow tanks Roadblock and Krieger, largely thanks to the Kiri-Ichimoji attack which slashes all the enemies around it.

For its Alpha variant, Murasame's weapon has changed to Itadorimaru, which trades off lower damage output for the ability to freeze enemies in place, making it easier for the rest of your team to focus their attacks. This means that it's more optimal than ever to stay close to your team, since there is no point freezing enemies somewhere your teammates can't get to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/06d62e9cd9cb4c6c66f65d29ec83ac47164eb7fa.jpg[/img]

Since the slippery ice effect of the counter-attack travels forward away from Murasame, you also have the added strategic consideration of which direction to aim for.[/i]


[b]Barrage Alpha: Rocket Hop[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/c6f950bfb25adad0efeda9e7353e2419f29c6878.jpg[/img]

[i]By default, Barrage uses a grenade launcher called the Skipbomber which fires projectiles in a parabola, so it's a little tricky to aim, but you don't need to hit enemies exactly since the explosions spread out on impact. The grenades set enemies on fire, so using Skipbomber and Triple Threat to keep dinosaurs ablaze as much as possible is the basic strategy for Barrage.

The Alpha variant of Barrage uses Bounce Blaster, a rocket launcher. This differs from the grenade launcher in that rockets travel in a straight line towards their target, so you can aim more easily and directly, but the trade-off is that rockets detonate directly on impact, so you will actually have to try to hit the enemy rather than aiming in its general direction as you would with the Skipbomber.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/0f5658caf24213aa6ee54fd019a125ad20ef38c0.jpg[/img]

You can also charge up rockets, which not only increases their damage output but adds a knockback effect during PvP against enemy Exofighters. Taking the right chances to let loose a charged shot is vital.

Also, the fire effect of the grenades is not present by default on the rockets, so if you want to set those dinos ablaze, you'll need to restore this effect using modules or simply through good old-fashioned teamwork.[/i]


[b]Nimbus Alpha: Double Barrel[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/936dc6d20cca08589e13bada7fa623835aac619d.jpg[/img]

[i]Playing as Nimbus involves switching between Attack and Support modes, and its default skill Mars & Apollo uses twin long-range pistols which necessitate positioning oneself to offer effective team support from a safe distance. Even while at a distance, Holo Warp allows the player to rush to the aid of a downed teammate to revive them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/7578ad727eee71e1921e80b943131d9ceae6d309.jpg[/img]

In its Alpha variant, Nimbus is equipped with dual shotguns called Bellona and Hygieia. As you might imagine, shotguns require much closer-range combat to maximise their effectiveness, which changes up the play style of Nimbus quite a lot and requires the player to stay physically closer to their team. This has its risks and rewards as increased proximity may get you into danger, but you have higher-powered firearms to get you out of those close encounters. Definitely give it a try![/i]


[b]Deadeye Alpha: Burst Fire[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/9fc79f8264580762b7a25a242889c4e557b0189a.jpg[/img]

[i]Deadeye's default variant is a versatile suit that uses a basic assault rifle, the Ravager, to offer an easily picked-up and played combat experience for any player. It's mainly focused on mid- to long-range attacks which require skilful positioning, but even at close range, the Ravager and Thrust Attack are effective tools in any situation. To put it bluntly, this suit is a "Jack of all trades", in the best possible way.

By contrast, the Alpha variant of Deadeye uses a different weapon called the Aggressor, which switches between a short-range spread attack and a down-the-sights five-shot burst useful at mid- to long-range. You'll have to make snap decisions about which mode to use depending on your distance from the enemy, but if you pick the right mode for the right range, you'll be rewarded with firepower that exceeds the default Deadeye suit. Specialization has its rewards![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/3a6859fb4f48ec5842e1821d2cc9be55f2f821e4.jpg[/img]

[i]One thing to note about the Aggressor is that its burst-fire mode feels quite different from the default Ravager, and requires more precise aiming. Hitting your target feels really great with this weapon![/i]


[b]Vigilant Alpha: Marksman[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/307d6582ca8b6796215160f775e97fecb6c628c5.jpg[/img]

[i]Vigilant is by default a pure sniper, using charged Railgun shots to deliver hits with pinpoint precision. Since all of its active skills are on the slower side, positioning and accuracy are key to its effective use.

This charging ability is gone when using the Alpha variant of Vigilant, replaced with a rapid-fire capability on its Preyfinder weapon. You'll still want to aim precisely at enemy weak points, but with faster shots you can afford to be a little more trigger-happy and adjust your aim as you attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/ad0989f441f4fa8cc64b888bc8b796afaeca2923.jpg[/img]

Preyfinder is a semi-automatic rifle, and one in every five shots is extra-powerful, so you'll want to make sure that one is going to hit its mark when you pull the trigger. It's easier to fire off the hip than the default, so you'll find Vigilant Alpha handier in close-quarters combat as well.[/i]


[b]Intel Summary[/b]

Exofighters, this concludes Director Hiraoka’s previews of all 10 new Alpha Variant exosuits coming to Exoprimal in Title Update 1 on August 16th, bringing the total selection of available suits to 20! 
If you missed out on our previous posts, you can learn more about the other Alpha Variant suits by clicking the links below:
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286320/announcements/detail/3678928662965381687]Skywave[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286320/announcements/detail/3644026942360830775]Zephyr, Roadblock, Krieger & Witchdoctor[/url]
[/list]
As a reminder, in order to access the Alpha Variants, you’ll just need to get the base version of the exosuits you want to unlock to level 20! 

We look forward to seeing your thrilling combat data from both Dino Survival and Savage Gauntlet with these new additions. 


[h1]Stand by for combat mission[/h1]

That wraps up the latest Hammerheads HQ post!

August 16th and Title Update 1 is rapidly approaching, so it won’t be long until your collecting high-quality combat data in your shiny new exosuits.

We’ll be back again in the near future with our next community blog post! 

In the meantime, follow Exoprimal on [url=https://twitter.com/exoprimal]Twitter[/url] and like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Exoprimal]Facebook[/url] for the latest Exoprimal news. 

Thanks, Exofighters, see you in the wargames!

- Exoprimal Community Team

notes.title: Hammerheads HQ #5 – Alpha Variant Suit Previews, Unlock Info and New Modules!
notes.content:
Hey Exofighters,

Welcome to Hammerheads HQ #5! 

For those of you that have completed Exoprimal’s story, we hope you enjoyed your time with last weekend’s Savage Gauntlet Trail 1! That was a lot of T. Rex’s for Downtown, right?!

In today’s post we’re taking a look forward as we prepare for Title Update 1’s arrival on August 16th, bringing with it the Alpha Variant suits, as well as new Modules! We’ll be sharing with you how you’ll unlock Alpha Variant Exosuits as well as detailing new info straight from Exoprimal’s Director Hiraoka on the new Modules, as well as four more of the Alpha Variant suits!

There’s lots of exciting new information today, so let’s swoop in like a swarm of Pteranodons!


[h1]New Modules and more Alpha Variant Suits[/h1]

Title Update 1’s new Variant suits are intended to change the combat range and strategy of each of the default suits by giving them different weapons, so we took a moment to speak with Exoprimal’s Director Hiraoka to get the finest of combat data on these upcoming additions!

But, before we talk about the suits themselves, let’s confirm how you’ll unlock them! 

[b]Unlocking Alpha Variant Exosuits[/b]

Once Title Update 1 is live, all 10 of the Alpha Variant Exosuits will be available to unlock and use in the wargames. To unlock and use the Alpha version of a given suit, you just need to get the base version of that exosuit to suit level 20. If you already have your favourite exosuits at level 20 or higher, you’ll be able to immediately access the Alpha versions for use in the wargames.

Now you know how to unlock the new exosuits, let’s see what exciting new info Director Hiraoka has to share on the new modules and a selection of the Alpha variant suits!


[h1]Director Combat Data - Additional Modules[/h1]

[i]Hey everyone! 

Title Update 1 will see the addition of new modules, both the base modules that any suit can equip, as well as suit modules for the Variant Alpha suits, as well as action modules that either the default or Variant Alpha suits can use.

These modules can be unlocked by raising your level - for base modules, this means your player level, while for the suit and action modules, you need to level up the relevant Variant Alpha suit.
Let's take a look at one of each type module.

The Renewal base module increases the HP that friendly suits will have after you recall them during battle when they are downed. Equipping this module on a tougher Tank suit or, say, Nimbus, which can use its Holo Warp to quickly reach downed allies, is sure to help your team shore up its frontline defences.

Next is the D - Linear Thrust action module for Deadeye. Equipping this lets you repulse enemy Exofighters and small dinosaurs when using the charged Strike Thrust. It's almost as if Deadeye is able to use Zephyr's Linear Strike! This module is equippable by both the standard and Alpha Variant of Deadeye.

A total of 34 new module are being added in this update, so I hope you look forward to trying them out on both kinds of suit and coming up with new loadouts and strategies![/i]


[h1]Director Combat Data – Alpha Variant Intel[/h1]

[b]Zephyr Alpha: Energy Chakram[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/73e1f92c3bd202eef464e4034cd966fd63bb9e39.jpg[/img]

[i]The default Zephyr is specialised for melee attacks, and you need to get close to enemies in order to hit them with its Tonfa Blitz attack, but since the suit has low HP,  you need to make good use of the Turbine Step to avoid taking damage. Another key factor in using this suit effectively is keeping an eye on the cooldowns of Linear Strike and Sky High, and using those moves at just the right moments when you need a burst of firepower.

In contrast to the close range style of the standard suit, Zephyr's Alpha Variant is more mid-range and uses the chakram on its arms to shoot energy halos. These have a critical distance at which they can do the most damage, so unlike the default suit you'll want to manage your distance from the enemy and not be too close-up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/5e7b931ba42c9dcc8c5c0aab37aaa23320a11749.jpg[/img]

Since Linear Strike or Sky High won't connect at a distance from your foes, Turbine Step changes from a dodge move to a gap-closer that lets you take advantage of opportunities to get up close, use melee moves and then get back to your critical distance.[/i]


[b]Roadblock Alpha: Fortress Shield[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/5efdf1a02eddd68bbbfe878097f73607cecbcca2.jpg[/img]

[i]Roadblock is, in its default form, the epitome of the Tank role, drawing in enemies with its taunt and taking their attacks for the team. Using its shield to hold back hordes of Raptors or a Triceratops is one of those quintessential Exoprimal moments that makes this such a reliable Exosuit.

While the default Roadblock is designed to become the frontline, the Alpha Variant lets you place a shield called a Sentinel Wall to create that line. This means you can draw enemies in towards your shield while you yourself move to another position, and your strategy is centred on where to place the shield rather than where you should be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/484ed65c887c1d607e077545f25b6b5bf10310a1.jpg[/img]

Retrieving the shield causes it to explode, which damages nearby enemies, so choosing the right moment to do so is a fun and useful technique![/i]


[b]Krieger Alpha: Charge Shotgun[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/9f2994cce0099eee62fd1ec25ccd21c50610b1ae.jpg[/img]

[i]Krieger's default K-40 Repulsor Minigun is effective at suppressing enemies using its wide-range firepower, and its active skills Dome Shield and Stunlock Missile work well in combination to stop the enemy onslaught in its tracks.

For the Alpha Variant, we've replaced its weapon with the A-40 Pulverizer, a massive shotgun. Each shot is more powerful than those of the minigun, but the ability to charge shots is the most unique aspect of this weapon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/882cab55b700839d2b3b49c1c4ee29fddd100b22.jpg[/img]

Uncharged shots have a wider spread, allowing you to damage multiple enemies in front of you, while charged shots compress the shot into a pinpoint attack on a specific spot which not only causes damage but can even knock smaller enemies back. This makes Krieger Alpha great at tackling specific enemies that need taken care of.[/i]


[b]Witchdoctor Alpha: Duality Beam[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/1970b632e0a3846e46e5e3f7d577506ee9e0b61d.jpg[/img]

[i]Witchdoctor's default Neuro Rod generates electricity which has a paralyzing effect across a wide area, so it doesn't require especially precise aiming to be effective. This lets players focus more on their positioning relative to their teammates and the timing at which to use this move.

This contrasts with the Alpha Variant of Witchdoctor, which uses a Quantum Rod which is more like Skywave's Aether Lance, in that it both damages enemies and heals allies. Its range is also changed to be a direct beam, so players will need to decide more specifically who they are aiming their attack or heal at. That said, even its normal attacks have a healing effect on allies, so if you position yourself well, you'll be able to put out more heals than with the default suit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/ad93c1180b3e0380cbf9cc0599d2083b4867b694.jpg[/img]

In addition, the longer you keep attacking an enemy, the strong the effect becomes, so moving around to keep your beam focused on one enemy will become a crucial technique on the battlefield.[/i]


[b]Intel Summary[/b]

How was that for a new intel drop from Director Hiraoka! So to summarise:
[list]
[*]34 new modules, some that work with both base and Alpha suits, with others designed specifically for Alpha Variants.
[*]Alpha Variant’s new weapons carve out dynamic new strategies.
[*]Unlock a suit’s Alpha Variants by getting the base version of the suit to level 20.
[*]Total playable exosuits are being doubled from 10 to 20 on August 16th!
[/list]
The wargames are evolving. We look forward to seeing how you incorporate these new exosuits in your battles against the dinosaurs and rival exofighters.


[h1]Stand by for combat mission[/h1]

That wraps up the latest Hammerheads HQ post!

We hope you all enjoyed this deeper dive into the new content coming to the game as part of Title Update 1!  

We’ll be back again soon for our next community post, as Director Hiraoka details the remaining Alpha Exosuits ahead of their arrival! 

In the meantime, follow Exoprimal on [url=https://twitter.com/exoprimal]Twitter[/url] and like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Exoprimal]Facebook[/url] for the latest Exoprimal news. 
Thanks, Exofighters, see you in the wargames!

- Exoprimal Community Team

notes.title: Hammerheads HQ #4 - Launch, Savage Gauntlet & Alpha Variant Suit Preview!
notes.content:
Hey Exofighters,

Exoprimal is live and the dinosaurs have arrived! We trust you’ve been collecting the finest quality combat data for Leviathan, whilst avoiding being turned into a crunch dino snack!

From everyone on the team, we’d like to say a big thank you for your amazing support, passion and feedback since launch! 

In today’s post we’re going to be chatting launch, taking a look at the upcoming Savage Gauntlet PvE exclusive mode and even getting a first deep dive into one of the new Alpha Variant Exosuits coming as part of free Title Update 1 in August!


[h1]Exoprimal Launch – Carnage Module Online[/h1]

To echo what we said in the post’s opening, thank you to everyone who has already joined us in the wargames! We hope you’re having a ton of fun as you clash with dinosaurs and Exosuits alike. 

For those of you who have suited up for the first time and dived into your first couple of matches, the wargames will evolve as you play through Exoprimal and discover more of its story. Completing your introductory wargames and initial progress of the Analysis Map will add additional dinosaurs, increased swarm density, new locations, more Final Missions, and even greater threats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/23d25c619e98a243ab75fe4dbb6cefffa962f61e.jpg[/img]

After all, Leviathan can’t have its favourite test subjects getting devoured immediately! But fear not, once you’ve got your first few wargames completed and the Analysis Map updated; Leviathan, *REDACTED* and the dinosaurs won’t hold back as the swarms turn your mini-map red and your screen a writhing mass of teeth and claws.

But this is just the start of your time with the Hammerheads and Leviathan’s wargames! Let’s take a look at what’s on the horizon:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/28e4ea5c73f6f4a3d6a7194642b347c528eea84b.jpg[/img]

That’s right, new Exosuit variants, maps, Final Missions, Capcom Collabs and more are on the way!

Let’s delve into a bit of what’s coming now.


[h1]Savage Gauntlet – Endgame PvE Challenges[/h1]

Get ready for Savage Gauntlet, a dynamic new mode coming to Exoprimal on July 28!

A separate mode from Dino Survival, Savage Gauntlet is a pure PvE mode designed to put veteran 5-person Exofighter teams to the test in special rotating weekly missions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/58eded3b4cffdfd3a34732f5a542b72f432941ca.jpg[/img]

It’s just you, your team of 5 and the dinosaurs. No rival Exofighters, no dominator. What will determine your success is mastery of your exosuits and your teamwork as you take on endgame content specifically designed with encounters and challenges on the upper end of the difficulty spectrum.

You can play this mode purely for fun and to test your team in high intensity PvE dino chaos, but this mode also comes with leaderboards! So, if you’re feeling competitive you can show exofighters from dimensions far and wide just how strong and robust your combat data generating skills are!
As mentioned, these missions will rotate each week, bringing with it new dino encounters for you to overcome and a fresh leaderboard to climb! 

Savage Gauntlet is an endgame experience with difficulty that reflects that and as such, will be unlocked for exofighters who have completed the game’s story.


[h1]A Message from the Director – Skywave Alpha Variant Intel![/h1]

On August 16, free Title Update 1 comes to Exoprimal and with it 10 new Alpha Variant exosuits, one for each current suit – no one’s missing out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/d041306f04025831b88e3eb0dd63dacd6607f75d.png[/img]

Each Alpha Variant exosuit has new playstyles, weapons, abilities and looks! We’ve spoken to the game’s director, Takuro Hiraoka, and got a deeper look into one of the suits, Skywave.

The concept of the variant suits is giving them different weapons to bring new range and strategy to each one compared to the base suits,” he explained before going into more detail using Skywave as an example. 

[i]By default, Skywave has abilities that allow it to attack or interfere with enemies while healing allies, including its default weapon the Aether Lance, and the active skill Optics Jammer. So the main strategy when using this Exosuit is deciding whether to be attacking or healing at any given time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/dd1008f6bd62464abca3686f5e1bc220e9b63613.jpg[/img]

However, the Alpha variant’s main weapon is the Tempest Lance, which allows you to choose between two different moves depending on whether or not you’ve charged the attack up: an offensive attack or a charged bolt which hampers enemy movement. This means players will have to switch between using their main weapon on enemies and their active skill when they want to heal their allies. So, all in all, you have to get into quite a different strategic mindset with the Alpha, which I think should be a lot of fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/db71297bb3c710cd37c69433c49b3005520f735c.jpg[/img]

Skywave is categorised as a Support suit, but the Alpha variant has less of a focus on healing, so I expect to see this lead to some changes in team composition as well as players rethinking their rig loadout to perhaps add in more support functions.[/i]


[h1]Stand by for combat mission[/h1]

That wraps up the latest Hammerheads HQ post!

We hope you’re all having a brilliant time with the wargames and thank you again for joining us in the battles against the dino threat!  

We’ll be back again in the near future for our next community post, but in the meantime, follow Exoprimal on [url=https://twitter.com/exoprimal]Twitter[/url] and like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Exoprimal]Facebook[/url] for the latest Exoprimal news. 

If you’re keen to see a little more of the Alpha Variant suits, you can get a little look at them in action here:

[previewyoutube=X1URu0mNMq0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks, Exofighters, see you in the wargames!

- Exoprimal Community Team

notes.title: Hammerheads HQ #3 - June Open Beta Test & Neo T. Rex Co-op Battle
notes.content:
Hey Exofighters,

Welcome to the third Hammerheads HQ post! We had some exciting Exoprimal news recently from both the Summer Game Fest and Capcom Showcase, including the news that we’re hosting a second Open Beta Test from Friday June 16th, 00:00 UTC to Sunday June 18th, 23:59 UTC!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/460dfd138e076c9c538c77fe2fe9d85e1f0fafeb.jpg[/img]

This Open Beta Test is another great opportunity to try out Exoprimal for free and get a slice of the dino-slaying action that awaits you at launch on July 14th. We’ve also mixed things up from the previous beta, removing some of the PvP focused missions and adding in something that’s sure to get those of you that enjoy co-op play and boss fights very amped up. More on that shortly…


[h1]Exoprimal Open Beta 2 – This week![/h1]

That’s right, Leviathan has summoned up fresh dinosaur super swarms for you to clash with this week! 

Open Beta 2 is open to any and everyone who wants to try a slice of Exoprimal ahead of launch and features cross-platform play with and against console platforms too!

Depending on when you see this post, the beta’s pre-load / download is available now, so head over to the Steam store page and get ready for combat! Like in the previous Open Beta, you’ll need a CAPCOM ID in order to play Exoprimal. If you already have a CAPCOM ID account you’re set to go, if not you can make one for free and real quick by [url=https://cid.capcom.com/en/]clicking here[/url]. 

We’re changing things up a little bit for Open Beta 2, removing some of the PvP missions and rotating in some PvE alternatives, including a battle so fearsome you’ll need 10 Exofighters working together to even stand a chance…

[previewyoutube=ZLjmp6XEpdM;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare yourselves to face the Neo T.Rex and its raptor super swarms! In this fight both teams of 5 must come together to form one uniform team of 10 Exofighters and work together to overcome a truly fearsome co-operative challenge, and one that Leviathan is very eager to get combat data on...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/81e7207e603a7b242a4bc01e5b11445483493a27.jpg[/img]

Topple the Neo T.Rex together and you all get the co-operative win, or fall at the jaws of this monstrosity and experience immediate… employee termination together.

To aid you in advance of your clash with a Neo T.Rex, we spoke to Exoprimal’s Director Hiraoaka to get some top tips to make sure you and your team come out in one piece…


[h1]A Message from Director Hiraoaka – Surviving a Neo T.Rex Encounter![/h1]

[i]Hello, everyone! Exoprimal director Takuro Hiraoka here with some tips for the second Exoprimal Open Beta Test. I’d like to focus on the 10-player co-op Neo Tyrannosaur battle that will sometimes appear as a special mission while playing the beta.

Let’s start with the basics: the body of the Neo Tyrannosaur is covered in growths. These are its weak spots, so you need to aim for them if you want to do any damage, as the rest of its body is invulnerable. The choice of which are is easiest to target will depend on the Exosuit you’ve chosen, so try to think strategically about what abilities you have and how best to use them.

As for the Neo Tyrannosaur’s attacks, you need to watch out for not only moves using its body such as bite attacks, but its laser beam, which is something you probably wouldn’t find on a normal T-rex! You might want to make sure your team’s tank is ready for that one, or perhaps have someone craft a wall.
If you see a WARNING! sign on the screen, that means that an AOE attack is incoming, so be aware of your surroundings and think fast about how to avoid it. You may be caught off guard the first time, but if you stay calm you should be able to figure it out. Not panicking is key!

The Neo Tyrannosaurus is one of the strongest Neosaurs in the game, but between 10 Exosuits you should be able to beat it. I hope you enjoy this special mission where you join forces with the opposing team to take this beast down!

Note: The Neo Tyrannosaurus battle in the open beta test has been designed specifically for this test, so you’ll be able to enjoy something a little different when you play it in the full game.[/i]


Take note of these tips and you may well emerge victorious after your epic clash. But, be warned, as Director Hiraoaka mentioned, this particular Neo Tyrannosaurus battle has been crafted specifically for the Open Beta Test, so prepare for an even more intense fight full of surprises at full launch. 


[h1]Stand by for combat mission[/h1]

That wraps up the latest Hammerheads HQ post!

We hope you all have a fantastic time in the Open Beta Test! If you haven’t yet, get those CAPCOM IDs ready, gather your team of Exofighters and prepare to face the Neo T.Rex!

We’ll be back in the near future for our next community post, but in the meantime, follow Exoprimal on [url=https://twitter.com/exoprimal]Twitter[/url] and like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Exoprimal]Facebook[/url] for the latest Exoprimal news. 

Oh and whilst you’re here, check out this recent video from the dev team as they take you through the start of Exoprimal with some new footage that includes character and suit customization, as well as how the game’s story will unfold:

[previewyoutube=GGZwb34OLSc;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks, Exofighters, see you in the wargames!

- Exoprimal Community Team

[h2]Bug Fixes & Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Exosuit Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/7dc16230c2c1ce4157f76250587027a675ee3843.png[/img]
[b]Deadeye[/b]
Deadeye was intended to be an exosuit that excelled at medium and long range combat, but it couldn't perform as expected in the first open beta test. We've made the suit more playable by adjusting the accuracy of its primary weapon and reducing the cooldown time for its Thrust Attack ability.
[code]- Ravager: Increased projectile speed and decreased damage dropoff at distance.
- Thrust Attack: Reduced cooldown time.[/code]
[b]Zephyr[/b]
In the first open beta test, Zephyr dealt far more damage than we anticipated to dinosaurs and exosuits alike. We still want to emphasize the high-risk, high-reward gameplay of Zephyr's maneuverability and melee attacks, so we've opted to slightly reduce the power and effective area of some abilities.
[code]- Tonfa Blitz: Reduced damage and effective area.
- Linear Strike: Reduced damage and effective area.
- Reduced the rate at which Zephyr's Overdrive Gauge charges when attacking dinosaurs.[/code]
[b]Barrage[/b]
We envisioned Barrage as an exosuit that can leverage a variety of attacks and abilities to deal damage across a wide area, but it didn't quite reach that level of versatility in the first open beta test. Decreasing the cooldown for Triple Threat and making Barrage's Stun Grenade more effective should allow players to make better use of the suit.
[code]- Stun Grenade: Increased damage and altered the reaction of enemy exofighters hit by this ability.
- Triple Threat: Reduced cooldown time.[/code]
[b]Vigilant[/b]
Vigilant was a bit too good at taking down hostile exosuits from long range, so we've made some damage adjustments to give exofighters more time to repair after being hit by Vigilant. Furthermore, we've also increased the cooldown timer for Frost Lock since Vigilant was excelling in close quarters combat despite its specialization as a long-range sniper.
[code]- Railgun Charge: Reduced damage.
- Frost Lock: Increased cooldown time.[/code]
[b]Roadblock[/b]
Roadblock was nearly unstoppable while guarding with its shield, so we've reduced the shield's durability for balance purposes. Also, we've increased Roadblock's primary attack damage so that players can also choose to go on the offensive when needed.
[code]- Haymaker: Increased damage.
- Ballistic Wall: Reduced durability.
- Reduced duration of the temporary defense buff granted when activating the shield, and reduced the rate of damage reduction while this temporary defense buff is active.[/code]
[b]Krieger[/b]
We felt that Krieger performed mostly as expected, but some of its abilities were still limited in their viability. Stunlock Missile will now function as a useful offensive ability instead of only as a mechanic to paralyze enemies.
[code]- Stunlock Missile: Increased damage.
- Thruster Dash: Changed direction and increased knockback distance of small dinosaurs hit by this ability.[/code]
[b]Murasame[/b]
Murasame was still dealing incredible damage even without utilizing its Rasetsu Stance. We've made adjustments to create a clear difference in power between regular attacks and Rasetsu Stance attacks that have been after a Vajra Counter. Similarly, we've reduced the cooldown timer for Vajra Counter so that players can more easily play as a "counter tank" and enter Rasetsu Stance.
[code]- Ichimonji: Reduced damage.
- Vajra Counter: Reduced cooldown time.[/code]
[b]Witchdoctor[/b]
Witchdoctor was underperforming in its ability to repair teammates when compared to other support suits. We've made some of Witchdoctor's repair abilities more potent and made other adjustments so that Witchdoctor can be used as the best exosuit for close-range repairs.
[code]- Repair Field: Increased the amount of health repaired and reduced cooldown time.
- Feed: Reduced cooldown time.[/code]
[b]Skywave[/b]
Skywave's offensive and support capabilities were unmatched whether it was in the air above or on the ground with other suits. Adjustments have been made to Skywave's power, repair potency, effective range, and ability timers. We have also increased Skywave's hitbox to be more in line with its appearance, and to encourage players to use its maneuverability to evade attacks.
[code]- Aether Lance: Reduced damage. Reduced amount of health repaired. Reduced the area of direct hit zones.
- Optics Jammer: Reduced the length of the vision jamming debuff applied to hostile exofighters.
- Expanded Skywave's hitbox to be more in line with its appearance.[/code]
[b]Nimbus[/b]
While Nimbus fulfilled its intended role as a dual support/assault exosuit, we got the impression that it was quite difficult to use effectively. We've made adjustments so that Nimbus can better play the support role and have also ramped up its damage-dealing capabilities when it needs to play as an assault suit. Finally, we've made its Overdrive more viable by increasing its damage to a fixed amount.
[code]- Mars & Apollo: Increased damage.
- Spreadshot: Reduced cooldown time.
- Antipode Burst: Greatly increased power.[/code]
[b]Rig Updates[/b]
We've adjusted cooldown timers for rigs to incentivize certain playstyles and make rig performance more balanced.
[code]- Reduced the cooldown time for the following rigs:
Cannon, Shield, Aid
- Increased the cooldown time for the following rigs:
Catapult, Drill Fist[/code]
[h3]Mission Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42523994/29552299ed8e96ac1bd711ea454c2a0772687735.png[/img]
[b]General Updates[/b]
Final missions lasted much longer than regular missions in the first open beta test, and victory or defeat was often decided simply by the results of the final mission. We've adjusted the balance of final missions and made it more advantageous for teams to quickly progress through the regular missions.
[code]- A variety of balance adjustments to final missions have been made.
- Reduced the time limit of final missions.
- The team with the most progress when a final mission reaches its time limit will now be declared the winner.[/code]
[b]Data Key Security Updates[/b]
Some matches would devolve into a stalemate when the Data Key was being repeatedly destroyed. We've made the following changes to address this.
[code]- Increased the movement speed of the Data Key relative to the number of people standing in its proximity.
- The durability of a Data Key will increase each time it is restored after being destroyed.[/code]
[b]Omega Charge Updates[/b]
The position of target objectives was unclear, and some matches would turn into a stalemate when the Omega Hammer was continually dropped and reset. We've made the following changes to address this.
[code]- A nav line will now appear and guide players to the target when the Hammer is fully charged. Target locations can also be seen through walls.
- Increased the time it takes for the Omega Hammer's position to be reset.
- Energy charged while the Omega Hammer was dropped will no longer be lost when the Omega Hammer's position is reset.[/code]
[b]Energy Taker Updates[/b]
Some players had trouble understanding how to acquire energy cartridges, and many times the mission would turn into a PvP stalemate. We've made the following changes to address this.
[code]- Reduced the number of energy cartridges required for victory.
- A certain number of energy cartridges will appear near each team's starting point when the mission begins.
- Energy cartridges will now be gained or lost immediately after an exofighter is defeated.
- The number of energy cartridges gained or lost immediately after defeating an exofighter has changed.
- Energy cartridges can now be acquired by successfully recalling teammates.
- The interval between energy cartridge provision periods has been adjusted.[/code]

A number of other, smaller bugs have also been fixed.
The Exoprimal team appreciates your interest and support, and we hope to see you in the wargame!
